## 1. Scope and source revisions {#scope}

This reference follows **kernel-visible differences**, with product details used only to put the architecture in context. The target scope is deliberately limited to `gfx942` and `gfx950`; it does not cover every `gfx9` target, CDNA 5, or RDNA.

::: {.reading-block}
**Default layout example:** wave64, dense **16×16×16 FP16 → FP32 MFMA**, one output block, `CBSZ=ABID=BLGP=0`. The wider-K example changes K to 32 on CDNA 4. Sparse, FP64 and scaled operations have separate layouts and conditions.
:::

```{=html}
{{< include /cdna-architecture-compare/_tables/scope.html >}}
```

The [CDNA 3 ISA](https://www.amd.com/content/dam/amd/en/documents/instinct-tech-docs/instruction-set-architectures/amd-instinct-mi300-cdna3-instruction-set-architecture.pdf) and [CDNA 4 ISA](https://www.amd.com/content/dam/amd/en/documents/instinct-tech-docs/instruction-set-architectures/amd-instinct-cdna4-instruction-set-architecture.pdf) reviewed here both carry **5 August 2025** on their covers. LLVM/Clang source checks use commit [`4e9d349ab86d`](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/tree/4e9d349ab86dc0a913db3cba11aa2763d6985aff). Web sources were checked on **13 November 2026**. PDF links use physical file pages, counted from 1.
